type.delay.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.delay.cfg.log_level.label: Log level

type.delay.cfg.mode.label: Essence
type.delay.cfg.n_channels.label: Number of channels
type.delay.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.delay.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.delay.cfg.slice_mode.help: Video is published band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the full frame (sub-frame latency). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. Disabled (default) = historical behaviour. At zero delay: follows the head grain of the source; at a delay of ≥ 1 frame: republishes the delayed grain band by band.
type.delay.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
